battlemap.settings.title: Settings
battlemap.settings.summary_body: Pause is handled from the top HUD. Use Return to Game to resume, or Return to Main Menu to exit the battle.
battlemap.settings.controls_body:
Build: place towers, barracks, and residence cards.
Wave: spawn the next enemy wave.
Exchange: resolve combat.
Cleanup: retire defeated units.
Finish: close the current battle day.
